body: Hi there! Thanks for the report. I've queued this for a reproduction check on Wails v3. We'll keep this open while we investigate.

Hi there! I reproduced this on Windows. A fix is queued. Thanks!

<details>
<summary>Test evidence</summary>

Tested v3.0.0-beta.22 ([pinned source](https://github.com/wailsapp/wails/commit/73d9940f7b837209d64b0a573854d3b5736aafff)). Each VM started from its clean test snapshot and ran offline.

Trigger: Creating a Worker (module and classic, by URL) from inside a module parent Worker on a page served by the Wails asset Handler (`wails.localhost`) in a WebView2 window on Windows.

Expected: All nested workers created by URL inside the parent worker start and post a message back (nestedUrlModule and nestedUrlClassic both 'ok'), as on a plain http origin or in stock Edge.

**Windows 11 24H2 ARM64 — reproduced**

```text
go build ./workflow-repro; run reviewed native Wails GUI probe (50-second application deadline)
Microsoft Windows NT 10.0.26100.0
go version go1.27.1 windows/arm64
REPRO_READY: top-level worker control passed
REPRO_OBSERVATION: phase=initial topLevelWorkerOk=true
REPRO_OBSERVATION: phase=trigger fetchOk=true nestedUrlModuleOk=false nestedUrlClassicOk=false nestedBlobImportOk=true nestedBlobInlineOk=true silentSignature=true
REPRO_OBSERVATION: phase=reset topLevelWorkerOk=true bugObserved=true
REPRO_ASSERTION: expected nestedUrlModuleOk=true nestedUrlClassicOk=true, actual nestedUrlModuleOk=false nestedUrlClassicOk=false silentSignature=true
```

The failing regression assertion is the evidence; compilation and setup succeeded.

Scope: a running native Wails window against this pinned source, with measured DOM/native observations. This does not establish behavior on other OS releases, Wails versions or untested interactions. Only the trigger and measurements listed above were tested. 

Revision selection: reported public tag. Results apply only to the pinned source and OS shown; an inferred version is not attributed to the reporter.

Independent evidence review agreed with these results.

</details>
